card.title: I Pulled Away First
card.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your new key. Come in now; I've made your favourite lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the lock without telling me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This key does both doors. Shall we try them before lunch gets cold?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stood outside on my birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get candles. You can let yourself into the kitchen while I find them.

mechanism: A rushes to restore access and celebration while avoiding direct acknowledgment of having changed the lock.
confusable: Unlike ordinary hospitality, repair efforts must respond to distance A caused while sidestepping that role.
comparison: D85-b turns the birthday complaint into candles and key use; D85-a turns hand-delivered unanswered mail into immediate writing.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
